CHAPTER.VERS: Simon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of Jesus Christ, our God and Savior.
seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;
For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified to me.
For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:
and this voice we [ourselves] heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.
knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spoke from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
